title: MCP: expose scene_add, scene_remove, scene_rename, scene_select tools
description: All four scene tools (scene_add, scene_remove, scene_rename, scene_select) are fully implemented in packages/authoring-ui/src/agent/registry.ts (lines ~1632-1686) but none are registered as MCP tools in packages/vite-plugin-agent-mcp/src/index.ts. Agents cannot script multi-scene documents. Fix: add MCP tool registrations for these four tools in index.ts, following the same pattern as existing tools (schema definition + handler delegation to agent bridge).
